items.why: Fear is easing as the stock rout pauses and dip buyers offer support while the Nasdaq attempts to recover from its worst rout in 19 months.
Chip stocks are recovering from steep losses as the Nasdaq rebounds, with AI stocks seeing some buying.
Dip buyers are stepping in as the rout pauses, lifting beaten-down names with the broader tape.
AI stocks are seeing some buying as the Nasdaq attempts to recover from its worst rout in 19 months.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up 1.44% and S&P futures up 0.58%, while the VIX falls 12.7% as fear eases.
summary: Stocks are bouncing back after the worst rout in 19 months, with the Nasdaq recovering as dip buyers return to beaten-down AI and chip names.
